During operation, MemoryExplorer / LMEE-Bench applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to episodic / exploration memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF pp. 2, 16–17): The agent writes episodic exploration memories on the fly and reuses them across later goals; the fixed write procedure is T2. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
